_note: The districts extract shipped in the backend image (read by catalogue-apply by default; a host file --districts=<file> overrides it). Every row is checked by modules/location/districts-extract.spec.ts. Build it with scripts/geo/fetch-osm-districts.ts and the official lists, review, and commit the file here. Empty until then: the districts step plans nothing.
